reviews.title: Top Tier Headset
reviews.comment: My favorite headset to date. I’ve used all the major brands. A50 X is very durable, flexible, light and comfortable. I can channel through my headset to my Xbox, PC and PS at a click of a button. If you do not want it to change the input of your display when you click that button, don’t run the additional HDMIs through the charge base. Headset is extremely loud so it will take some time to perfect game audio against chat audio but you’ll hear everything. I can also, connect my phone’s audio without removing chat and game audio, so I can watch videos while I wait to load in, or even take a phone call, it will auto mute you to the party so people can’t hear your conversation. Make sure you get the right version for you though. If you don’t have multiple systems, you’ll save some money if you get the one specific to your system.
reviews.author: Ant Russell
